svg.aria-label: Slope chart of our percentile ranking against ALE-Bench over the 37 models the two share, at least 5 being the threshold to correlate at all, transposed into two rows: the leaderboard's order on top and our percentile ranking below, rank 1 at the left, both rows running 1 to n inside the shared set. One line per model joins its position on the top row to its position on the bottom row, in the model's registry colour; the ranks print along each row, one number per rank, and each model's name hangs under its bottom dot at 45 degrees; models tied on a row share one average rank and are drawn in the slots the tie occupies, joined by a thin horizontal tie mark on that row; the two row words are ALE-Bench and Heuristic Bench (ours). Kendall tau over the model ranks is +0.57, n = 37.
